This FloPlast cast iron effect half round external stop end in black is designed for 112mm standard guttering systems, providing a robust and aesthetic finish for external drainage. Manufactured from durable uPVC, this stop end offers the traditional appearance of cast iron without the associated upkeep, making it ideal for both new builds and renovation projects. It features pre-lubricated seals, ensuring quick and easy installation. It delivers a maintenance-free finish that does not require painting.
